notes_for_editor: Design and both dates rest on one page (firelookout.com). The FFLA list confirms only 'Ground Gone'. Two web searches found no second record of a Sanders County lookout here. An unread search result (a 2022 hiking listing) mentions an old rock lookout at an Elk Mountain near Trout Creek; it may be a different peak, and the page was not read. The record's coordinates were not checked against the '8 miles northeast of Trout Creek' description. Four Elk Mountain lookouts appear in the FFLA list (Sanders, Lincoln, Flathead, Missoula); the story keeps the Lincoln one (NHLR US 1504) apart. No access source found, so facts.access is omitted. Record kind 'ground' and status 'gone' agree with the sources; no corrections proposed.
